{{Quote|I may not be the Sith you're looking for&mdash;but I'll happily kill you anyway.|Darth Luft, to [[Jao Assam]]|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
'''Darth Luft''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[One Sith]]. He sported the traditional [[Sith tattoo]]s all over his body and wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Following the defeat of the One Sith at the end of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Luft went underground and became the leader of a pirate syndicate based in the abandoned [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Using a scam, he lured many [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] back to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] where they forced to work as slaves building ships for the pirates. In [[138 ABY]], his operation was discovered by the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] and the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] who informed the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], the new galactic government. A Triumvirate task force [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|liberated]] the shipyards, apprehended the pirates, and freed the slaves. During the assault, Darth Luft was killed in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with Jao Assam.

==Biography==
{{Quote|...But I was thinking, if I brought you this information, maybe...you'd release my son Tilin?''"<br />"''That's one possibility.|Tikin and Darth Luft, before the latter kills the former|<ref name="Legacy 9" />}}
[[File:Duel_Jao_Luft.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Luft duels [[Jao Assam]] in the Mon Calamari Shipyards.]]
Darth Luft was a Twi'lek One Sith who lived during the time of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|death]] of Darth Krayt in [[138 ABY]], Luft became the leader of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] syndicate which operated a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ring over the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Legacy 8" /> He and his pirate associates<ref name="Legacy 9" /> succeeded in luring a large number of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] back to Dac and enslaving them for labor to build a fleet of ships in the abandoned Mon Calamari Shipyards.<ref name="Legacy 8" />

As Luft began operation of a slave ring over Dac, he sent emissaries to [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]] and found that there was no interest in a dead planet. He did not think too highly of [[Darth Wredd]], considering him arrogant and undisciplined, and would have killed him had he come to Dac. After encountering [[Ania Solo]], Jao Assam, and their Mon Calamari and Quarren companions, Luft realized that they were on their own and sent them all to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that jettisoned into the [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Water/Legends|waters]] below.<ref name="Legacy 8" /> After [[Sauk]] and [[AG-37]] saved the quartet, Assam warned his master [[Yalta Val]] of the growing presence of pirates in the Dac system spearheaded by Darth Luft. In response, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and Yalta Val dispatched a fleet and complement of [[Imperial Knight]]s to deal with the Sith and his pirate associates. One the rescued group, the Quarren [[Tikin]], informed on the intruders' whereabouts in a desperate attempt to secure the release of [[Tilin]], the Quarren's son. Luft instead threw Tikin from a height, killing the Quarren.<ref name="Legacy 9" />

While engaged in combat with the Imperial Knight, Luft was carried away by the flood triggered by the arrival of Yalta Val and his cadets. The fight resumed and seemingly ended when Luft threw Assam into the water. Imperial Knight cadets arrived and dueled Luft, but were effortlessly defeated. However, Assam succeeded in sneaking up behind the Sith and killing Luft by impaling him with his lightsaber. Following Darth Luft's death, the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] apprehended his pirate associates and liberated the enslaved Mon Calamari and Quarren. Darth Luft's death played into the hands of Darth Wredd because it furthered his goal of destroying the One Sith in order to re-institute the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. Wredd personally contacted Jao afterwards to thank him for his "help".<ref name="Legacy 10" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Kill them all. They're expendable and then execute their families.|Darth Luft ordering his men to kill the Mon Calamari and Quarren slaves|<ref name="Legacy 9" />}}
[[File:Darth_Luft_and_his_pirate_buddies.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Luft and his pirate buddies]]
Darth Luft was an exceptionally tall red-skinned Twi'lek. Like other members of the One Sith, his face and body were [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] in red and black [[Sith tattoo|Sith markings]].<ref name="Legacy 8" />

As a Sith, Darth Luft had little regard for the lives of other sentient beings. This was best exemplified when he ordered the killing of the Mon Calamari and Quarren dependents and elderly following the outbreak of a slave revolt.<ref name="Legacy 10" /> In addition, Luft had a cruel and sadistic streak as shown when he killed Tikin.<ref name="Legacy 9" /> As a member of the insurgency One Sith, Luft supported the post-Second Imperial Civil War policy of going underground and rebuilding the Sith's capabilities and resources. He regarded the rogue Sith Darth Wredd as arrogant and undisciplined.<ref name="Legacy 8" /> He also had a thorough hatred for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] users like the Imperial Knight Jao Assam.<ref name="Legacy 10" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Huh. Not much sport in this after all. Unfortunate.|Luft's last words, before being killed by Jao|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
Darth Luft was skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and was capable of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to levitate other sentient beings and objects, as shown when he threw Tikin and tried to submerge Jao Assam under a piece of wreckage.<ref name="Legacy 9" /><ref name="Legacy 10" />
